title: File Locksmith Crash
author: asinghmodesttree
summary: File Locksmith repeatedly crashes with native access violations in its Interop DLL; active upstream pull requests already target the unsafe handle-enumeration and hang-recovery path.
next_action: Track PRs #49502 and #50217, then verify the crash signature after the selected fix lands.

confidence.rationale: The public discussion and linked ownership evidence support this classification.

judgment.rationale: The access-violation crash is covered by two live File Locksmith pull requests, including the newer isolation change in PR #50217. Starting a competing design would duplicate active upstream work.
evidence: Several users reproduce an access violation in PowerToys.FileLocksmithLib.Interop.dll on PowerToys 0.100.2.
PR #49502 explicitly targets File Locksmith Interop access violations caused by TerminateThread hang recovery.
PR #50217 is an open, newer File Locksmith change that isolates handle enumeration and is linked from this issue.
judgment.recommended_action: Track PRs #49502 and #50217, then verify the crash signature after the selected fix lands.

fix_assessment.rationale: Open PRs #49502 and #50217 are concrete implementation attempts for the reported native crash path.

issue_context.summary: File Locksmith repeatedly crashes with native access violations in its Interop DLL; active upstream pull requests already target the unsafe handle-enumeration and hang-recovery path.
known_information: The crash occurs while scanning folders and can happen whether or not a lock is found.
Event Viewer identifies exception 0xc0000005 in PowerToys.FileLocksmithLib.Interop.dll.
Fresh diagnostic archives and WER evidence were supplied by multiple reporters.
PRs #49502 and #50217 remain open and are directly linked to this crash family.
inferences: The native enumeration worker's cancellation or isolation behavior is the most likely owner of the crash.
Verification should match the exact Interop access-violation signature rather than treating every File Locksmith exit as the same defect.
issue_context.analysis: Public crash signatures and linked implementation work are already specific. The appropriate lightweight outcome is to track the existing fix attempts and avoid creating another plan.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the full live discussion, diagnostic links, Event Viewer signatures, labels, and cross-referenced pull requests.
Revalidated that PR #49502 and PR #50217 are currently open.
